title: bumelia lucida
intro: Bumelia lucida, commonly known as the Shining Bumelia, is a type of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Bumelia lucida include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
